scope: 0.9 strict-sequence step 3 (rectified): one fully successful improve-strategy composite journey plus a service-boundary fault matrix. no Community repository inspection or copy
evidence_rule: Missing real evidence MUST be FAIL/BLOCKED. A health check, a declared result, a page/endpoint existence, a unit fixture, or a hardcoded generation/epoch number is never a PASS.

composite_journey.isolation: dedicated compose project + dedicated network/volumes + loopback-only ports + fresh synthetic PostgreSQL

fault_matrix.boundaries: R1-R5 service boundaries: gateway-product-api, backend, gateway, ml-worker, backend-domain, runtime-adapter
fault_matrix.provenance_rule: trace/run/generation/epoch/pid are either a real value with a contract-allowed source (trace associated with the scenario receipt) or literal not_applicable with a reason. Hardcoded generation/epoch without a source is rejected.

optional_rows.reason: a real host reboot is not authorized and is not equivalent to a container restart

acceptance_gates.requirement: The composite journey runs end-to-end with every required step PASS and consistent lineage/owner/workspace/original-key/approval/identity/report.
Every required PASS scenario carries real per-scenario provenance (or explicit not_applicable + reason); no hardcoded generation/epoch is accepted.
Every required fault row is PASS with the six assertions, real before/after authoritative counts, correct boundary and no orphan.
The observer is fail-able and every negative control exits non-zero, including provenance, revoke/stale, cancel-completed, late-delta and boundary-impersonation controls.
Isolated stack only; production untouched; cleanup leaves zero containers/networks/volumes.
No missing evidence is labeled PASS; failures are labeled FAIL/BLOCKED with a reason.
